brand.name: ManHair
brand.voice: Human, direct, conservative. No fake proof, no manufactured scarcity, no treatment guarantees, no fabricated appointments or availability. One idea and one call-to-action per email.

essential.cadence: 13 visits/year on a 4-week cadence, not monthly calendar visits

signature.cadence: 13 visits/year on a 4-week cadence, not monthly calendar visits

elite.cadence: 13 visits/year on a 4-week cadence, not monthly calendar visits

locked_terms.system_lead_time: 8 to 12 weeks for first system; billing can begin before the first fitting occurs

pause_policy.approval: requires a request and manual review; not automatic

locked_terms.founding_offer_status: OFF — no founding, charter, or early-bird pricing/framing may appear anywhere
locked_terms.tax: No tax is currently collected; copy must never claim a tax exemption
locked_terms.statement_descriptor: MODFXMEDIA LLC — must be disclosed to the member before payment is submitted
locked_terms.receipt_policy: If Stripe's automatic receipt emails are enabled for the account, the internal payment confirmation email must be suppressed (no duplicate receipt)

global_safety.no_fake_proof: No testimonials, reviews, counters, or client photos may be used unless real and rights-cleared; none exist in this draft.
global_safety.no_scarcity_language: No countdowns, 'limited spots,' 'only X left,' or urgency framing anywhere in pages or emails.
global_safety.no_treatment_guarantees: No language implying guaranteed results, guaranteed timelines, or guaranteed appointment availability.
global_safety.no_fabricated_appointments_or_dates: Any date, time, or appointment referenced in copy must come from a real, server-confirmed record via a placeholder token, never invented.
global_safety.one_idea_one_cta_per_email: Every email in this draft contains exactly one message and one call-to-action.
global_safety.no_claims_of_successful_deployment_or_se: This entire document is an unreviewed draft. Nothing in it has been built, connected, deployed, sent, or tested. No claim of successful delivery, sync, or automation is made or implied.
global_safety.placeholder_discipline: Any fact not explicitly provided (URLs, amounts, dates, sender identities, recipients) is represented with an explicit {{PLACEHOLDER_NOT_CONFIGURED}} token — never guessed or invented.
global_safety.payment_status_verification: A member is only shown or told they are 'paid' or 'active' after a server-confirmed Stripe event (e.g., a verified webhook). A checkout-page redirect alone is never sufficient.
global_safety.consent_separation: Terms-of-service consent (required) and marketing consent (optional, default unchecked) are always presented, recorded, and revocable as two separate choices.
global_safety.placeholder_rendering: Block unresolved tokens; booking CTA disabled until real approved URL exists. Never show internal placeholders publicly.
global_safety.payment_copy_scope: Verify dedicated ManHair account/customer/membership metadata; deduplicate event plus business transition. No account-wide payment messages.
global_safety.activation: All templates enabled=false. Exact send approval, consent, approved sender/recipients and legal/business review required.

sections.heading: Three membership options
sections.body: ManHair memberships run on a 13-visit annual cadence — systems and maintenance visits spaced every 4 weeks, not once a month by the calendar. Pick the plan that matches the number of systems included each year; all three include the same visit frequency.

sections.heading: Essential — $449/month
sections.body: 4 systems and 9 maintenance visits per year, for a total of 13 visits on a 4-week cadence. A straightforward option if you want fewer system replacements and more maintenance visits in between.

sections.heading: Signature — $559/month
sections.body: 6 systems and 7 maintenance visits per year, for a total of 13 visits on a 4-week cadence. Signature is pre-selected by default; choose the plan that suits you.

sections.heading: Elite — $669/month
sections.body: 8 systems and 5 maintenance visits per year, for a total of 13 visits on a 4-week cadence, with priority scheduling for your appointments.

sections.heading: How billing works
sections.body: Every plan requires a $495 setup payment, charged immediately and credited in full toward the cost of your first system. Your first recurring monthly charge happens exactly 30 days after signup; after that, billing runs on a calendar-month cycle. Systems typically take 8 to 12 weeks of system lead time; your fitting date must be confirmed separately — billing can begin before that first fitting takes place. Membership requires a 3-month minimum commitment, after which it continues month-to-month, with your monthly rate locked for 24 months.

sections.heading: Your selected plan
sections.body: You've selected the {{SELECTED_PLAN_NAME}} plan at {{SELECTED_PLAN_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, including {{SELECTED_PLAN_SYSTEMS}} systems and {{SELECTED_PLAN_MAINTENANCE_VISITS}} maintenance visits per year, for 13 total visits on a 4-week cadence.

sections.heading: What you're paying today
sections.body: $495.00 is due now and will be charged to your card today. This amount is credited in full toward the cost of your first system — it is not an additional fee on top of your system cost.

sections.heading: What you'll pay going forward
sections.body: Your first recurring charge of {{SELECTED_PLAN_MONTHLY_PRICE}} will be billed exactly 30 days from today, on {{FIRST_RECURRING_CHARGE_DATE}}. After that, you'll be billed {{SELECTED_PLAN_MONTHLY_PRICE}} on a calendar-month cycle. Your system typically takes 8 to 12 weeks of system lead time; your fitting date must be confirmed separately; this billing schedule can begin before that fitting happens.

sections.heading: Membership terms
sections.body: Your membership requires a 3-month minimum commitment, after which it continues on a month-to-month basis. Your monthly rate is locked for 24 months from signup. You may request a pause of up to 60 days per year; pause requests are reviewed and are not automatically approved. Charges on your statement will appear under the descriptor MODFXMEDIA LLC. No sales tax is currently being collected on this purchase. For questions about cancellation or changes to your membership, contact {{SUPPORT_CONTACT_NOT_CONFIGURED}}.

sections.heading: Required: Terms consent
sections.body: I have read and agree to the ManHair Membership Terms, including the $495 setup payment credited toward my first system, the billing schedule shown above, the 3-month minimum commitment followed by month-to-month billing, and the 24-month rate lock. This consent is required to continue. (Checkbox, unchecked by default, must be checked to proceed.)

sections.heading: Optional: marketing consent
sections.body: Send me optional marketing emails from ManHair about services, plans, and updates. This is not required, is unchecked by default, and will not affect my membership, billing, or service in any way. (Checkbox, unchecked by default.)

sections.heading: Submit
sections.body: By submitting, you authorize a charge of $495.00 today under the statement descriptor MODFXMEDIA LLC, and authorize future recurring charges of {{SELECTED_PLAN_MONTHLY_PRICE}} beginning {{FIRST_RECURRING_CHARGE_DATE}} per the terms above.

sections.heading: We're confirming your payment
sections.body: Your submission was received and we're waiting for confirmation from our payment processor. This usually takes only a few moments. Please do not submit another payment while this one is being checked.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.body: Once your payment is verified, you'll be taken to a confirmation screen and sent a welcome email. If verification takes longer than expected or doesn't succeed, this page will update to tell you exactly what to do next — we will not show you as a paid member until payment is actually confirmed.

sections.heading: Payment confirmed
sections.body: Your $495.00 setup payment has been verified and will be credited toward your first system. Welcome to ManHair. This page is only shown after your payment processor has confirmed the charge — not based on simply reaching this page.

sections.heading: What's next
sections.body: Your system typically takes 8 to 12 weeks of system lead time; your fitting date must be confirmed separately. We'll keep you updated by email along the way. When it's time to schedule, you'll do so at {{BOOKING_URL_NOT_CONFIGURED}}.

sections.heading: Your billing schedule
sections.body: Your next charge of {{SELECTED_PLAN_MONTHLY_PRICE}} is scheduled for {{FIRST_RECURRING_CHARGE_DATE}}, and will continue on a calendar-month cycle after that.

sections.heading: Go to your account
sections.body: You can review your plan, billing, and visit cadence anytime from your dashboard.

sections.heading: Next bill
sections.body: Your next charge is {{NEXT_INVOICE_AMOUNT}} on {{NEXT_INVOICE_DATE}}, sourced directly from your active subscription record.

sections.heading: Your visit cadence
sections.body: Your plan includes 13 visits per year, scheduled at a 4-week cadence — not once per calendar month. {{VISITS_COMPLETED_COUNT}} of 13 visits completed this membership year.

sections.heading: Service readiness
sections.body: System lead time is typically 8 to 12 weeks. Current status: {{SERVICE_READINESS_STATUS_NOT_CONFIGURED}}.

sections.heading: Pause your membership
sections.body: You can request a pause of up to 60 days per year. Submitting a request does not pause your membership automatically — requests are reviewed before approval.

sections.heading: Billing & payment history
sections.body: View past charges, update your payment method, or review your billing history. This section reflects your billing account separately from your membership and visit status above.

sections.heading: Sign in
sections.body: Sign in with your Griselda Hub account. This login is local to the Hub and is separate from any GoHighLevel/GHL user account — a Griselda login does not imply GHL access, and vice versa.

sections.heading: Pipeline board
sections.body: View and manage deals across the pipeline stages: New Leads, Hot Leads, Proposal Sent, Phone Consult, Video Consultation, No show/Cancelled, Active Clients, No Buy/Nurture, DND. Move a deal using the stage dropdown on its card, or drag it directly to a new stage column.

sections.heading: GHL sync status
sections.body: Each deal shows its real sync state with GHL: 'Synced' (last confirmed sync time shown), 'Pending sync' (change queued, not yet confirmed), or 'Sync failed — {{SYNC_ERROR_DETAIL}}' (with a retry option). No deal is ever labeled 'Synced' without a confirmed successful API response.

sections.heading: Save a stage change
sections.body: Confirm a stage move. The change is saved locally immediately and queued for GHL sync; the sync status above will update once GHL confirms or rejects the update.

acceptance_checks: No page or email is enabled, scheduled, or sent as a result of this document; all remain disabled drafts pending review.
Every 'paid'/'active' status shown to a member is gated on a server-confirmed Stripe webhook event, never on a checkout redirect alone.
The internal payment confirmation email is suppressed whenever Stripe's automatic receipt emails are confirmed enabled on the account.
Webhook-driven emails (payment_failed, payment_recovered, pause approvals, status updates) process events using idempotency keys to prevent duplicate sends.
The terms checkbox is required and blocks submission; the marketing checkbox is optional, unchecked by default, and never pre-checked or bundled with terms.
The signup page displays both the $495 charge-now amount and the selected plan's future monthly amount/date clearly before the final submit action.
No cancellation deadline, proration rule, guarantee, included-but-unspecified service, or booking URL is hard-coded anywhere; all use explicit {{...NOT_CONFIGURED}} placeholders until confirmed.
No founding/early-bird/charter pricing or framing appears anywhere, per FoundingOFF.
Tax line items show $0 collected and never claim a tax exemption.
The MODFXMEDIA LLC statement descriptor is disclosed to the member before payment is submitted.
Lead-time emails (week 2, 8, 12) never state a guaranteed or promised delivery/fitting date.
The care-after-fitting email is not activated until provider-approved care guidance copy replaces {{APPROVED_CARE_GUIDANCE_NOT_CONFIGURED}}.
Consultation nurture emails only enroll leads with explicit, recorded marketing opt-in, and exit immediately on signup, booking, DND, unsubscribe, bounce, or complaint.
The abandoned-signup email only sends where explicit follow-up consent was captured; it is never triggered by an email address alone, and never implies a card was charged.
Pause acknowledgement and pause-approved emails are distinct templates tied to distinct events; approval is never implied by submission alone.
The recurring charge reminder timing is derived from the real Stripe next-invoice date (T‑3 days), never a fabricated or estimated date.
Griselda Hub authentication is verified to be a separate system from GHL user accounts before go-live.
GHL sync status on the deal board reflects actual API responses (Synced/Pending/Failed with detail) and never defaults to 'Synced' optimistically.
No workflow, automation, or lead enrollment in GHL is activated as a byproduct of this document; all mappings below are design references only.
Before activation, sender domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), reply-to address, and all internal alert recipients are configured and confirmed.

ghl_mapping.billing_state_separation: Membership billing state (plan, invoice status, pause status) is tracked in the billing/subscription system, not as a CRM pipeline stage. A contact moving to 'Active Clients' reflects sales/CRM status only and must not be read as a live billing status.
ghl_mapping.griselda_auth_note: The Griselda Deal Hub uses its own local authentication. A Griselda Hub login does not create, require, or imply a GoHighLevel user account, and the two systems must be treated as independently authenticated.
ghl_mapping.automation_status: All mappings above are semantic design references only. No GHL workflow, trigger, automation, or lead enrollment has been created, enabled, or deployed as part of this document.
